priorityList: Use offensive Trinkets, Potions, and Power Infusion during Metamorphosis.
Cast Voidblade followed by The Hunt if you are at maximum Void Metamorphosis stacks with Devourer's Bite and Voidsurge talented.
Use Metamorphosis on cooldown, prioritizing windows where Eradicate is active.
Cast Void Ray if the Eradicate buff is not currently active.
Execute the Reaps sequence (Eradicate > Cull > Reap) if you have 4 or more souls consumed while Metamorphosis is active.
Cast Pierce the Veil if Moment of Craving is active and Collapsing Star is ready.
Cast Voidblade if Moment of Craving is active and Collapsing Star stacks are near maximum.
Use Collapsing Star if it won't interfere with Voidrush or Predator's Wake cooldowns.
Execute the Reaps sequence (Eradicate > Cull > Reap) if Metamorphosis is down but Moment of Craving is active.
Use Vengeful Retreat when Voidstep is active to maintain mobility and buffs.
Cast Reapers Toll if the Voidsurge/Reapers Toll proc is active.
Cast The Hunt if Metamorphosis is active (unless Voidsurge is talented).
Cast Pierce the Veil and Predators Wake on cooldown.
Cast Voidblade as your primary generator during Metamorphosis or when Duty Eternal is talented.
Cast Devour and Consume as low-priority fillers to generate resources.
